# Moshe Farber

> Moshe Farber is a Fractional CMO & Executive Growth Partner and the founder of C-Level Accelerator Corp. (founded 2023). He works with business owners and leadership teams of growing companies, leading strategy, marketing and customer experience.

## Who he is
- Name: Moshe Farber
- Title: Fractional CMO · Executive Growth Partner
- Company: C-Level Accelerator Corp. (also written C-Level Accelerator), founded 2023
- Experience: more than 15 years leading marketing, strategy and customer experience; a former agency founder and two-time full-time CMO
- Coaching: business coaching and consulting with Rock Leadership Solutions (RLS)
- Education: business studies, Touro College
- Book (forthcoming): The Marketing Leader You Didn't Know You Needed: Inside the Role of a Fractional CMO That Turns Strategy Into Growth
- Newsletter: The Marketing Mindset: Daily Sparks for Growth, a short daily idea for business owners, delivered on WhatsApp

## What he offers
- Fractional CMO: part-time in hours, full-time in responsibility. Executive marketing leadership on the leadership team, working with the existing staff, freelancers and agencies.
- Go-to-market for new ventures
- Coaching & consulting
- Leadership-team workshops: full-day sessions for clarity and goal planning, as a single session or on a set rhythm through the year

## Who he works with
Growth-focused businesses, typically small to mid-sized companies or divisions of larger firms, that have customers and revenue and need stronger leadership to scale.

## Not to be confused with
Other people share the name Moshe Farber (for example, people working in supply-chain management and in software engineering). This site is about Moshe Farber the Fractional CMO and founder of C-Level Accelerator.
